title: Universal Web Scraper - Complete Configuration
description: Unified configuration for crawling, scraping, and data extraction across any website

mode.title: Execution Mode
mode.description: Choose workflow mode based on your needs
enumTitles: Full Auto (Recommended) - Automatically detect and execute
Scrape Only - Extract data from provided URLs
Crawl Then Scrape - Discover all URLs, then scrape all
Stream Scrape - Scrape URLs as discovered

startUrls.title: Start URLs (for crawling)
startUrls.description: URLs to start crawling from (used in crawl modes)

urls.title: URLs to Scrape (for scrape-only mode)
urls.description: Specific URLs to scrape (used in scrape-only mode)

fields.title: Fields to Extract
fields.description: List of fields to extract from pages

maxDepth.title: Max Crawl Depth
maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to crawl (0 = start URLs only)

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl

maxItems.title: Max Items to Extract
maxItems.description: Maximum number of data items to extract

followPatterns.title: URL Patterns to Follow
followPatterns.description: Only follow URLs matching these patterns (e.g., '/product/', '/item/')

handlePagination.title: Handle Pagination
handlePagination.description: Automatically discover and crawl paginated content

discoverApis.title: Discover APIs
discoverApis.description: Intercept network requests to discover API endpoints

enableSearchDiscovery.title: Enable Search Enumeration
enableSearchDiscovery.description: Enable query enumeration for search-required websites

searchConfig.title: Search Discovery Configuration
searchConfig.sectionDescription: For websites that require search to see results

resultLimit.title: Result Limit
resultLimit.description: Expected result limit per query (0 = auto-detect)

schemaConfig.title: Schema Configuration
schemaConfig.description: Configure output schema for stable data structure
schemaConfig.sectionDescription: Ensure stable output even when websites change

useSchema.title: Use Predefined Schema
useSchema.description: Apply schema for stable output structure

schemaType.title: Schema Type
schemaType.description: Select predefined schema or use auto-generated

strictSchema.title: Strict Schema Mode
strictSchema.description: Fail if required fields are missing

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: API keys for AI providers and other services

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API Key
openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for AI-powered extraction

browserConfig.title: Browser Configuration
browserConfig.description: Settings for JavaScript rendering and browser automation

useCamoufox.title: Use Camoufox Browser
useCamoufox.description: Use Camoufox (advanced anti-detection) instead of Playwright. Recommended for challenging websites.

waitForNetworkIdle.title: Wait for Network Idle
waitForNetworkIdle.description: Wait for all network requests to complete
